Extract OpenStreetMap network in sf format

Source: R/network_tools.R
street_network_to_sf.Rd

The street network in sf format: the vertices at the ends of street edges and every directed street edge (the connectors of transit stops and park-and-rides left out), in the order of the network's edge index.

Usage

street_network_to_sf(network)

Arguments

network

A network built with build_network().

Value

A list with two sf data frames in WGS 84: vertices (POINT), with columns index, park_and_ride, bike_sharing and geometry, and edges (LINESTRING), with columns edge_index, osm_id, from_vertex, to_vertex, street_class, length (meters), walk, car, car_speed (km/h), bicycle, bicycle_lts and geometry. Package 'sf' is needed. With options(peabiru.output = "data.table"), edges is an sf data.table and vertices a plain sf data frame (see peabiru-package).

See also

Other network functions: build_network(), check_transit_availability(), find_snap(), get_gtfs_errors(), street_network_bbox(), transit_network_to_sf()

Examples

data_path <- system.file("extdata/spo", package = "peabiru")
network <- build_network(data_path, n_threads = 2)
street_net <- street_network_to_sf(network)
head(street_net$edges)
